comic-to-realistic v1.0.0

- Initial release: Convert comic/anime/illustration images into high-quality realistic portraits.
- Supports prompt optimization and automatic enhancement for photorealistic output.
- Designed for creative use cases including character visualization, social media, and content design.
- Best results with high-res, clear, single-character images; supports async processing via API.
- Detailed documentation on optimal prompt structure and workflow integration included.
